en.text: Last year, I traveled abroad with a friend.
Last year, I traveled overseas with some friends.

original: 友達に携帯電話の番号を教えました。

en.text: I gave my cell phone number to a friend.

original: 毎月海外の友達に手紙を書きます。

en.text: I write a letter to a friend overseas every month.
Every month, I write letters to my friends overseas.

original: 明日友達と映画を見に行きます。

en.text: I'm going to see a movie tomorrow with friends.
I'm going to see a movie tomorrow with a friend.

original: 昨日、友達に出会った。

en.text: I saw a friend of mine yesterday.

original: 私の彼ね、女友達が多いのよ。

en.text: My boyfriend has a lot of female friends.

original: 私の彼氏、異性の友達が多いのよね。

en.text: My boyfriend has a lot of female friends.

original: 友達を全員招待したんだ。

en.text: I invited all my friends.

original: 明日、友達が来るんだ。

en.text: My friend is coming over tomorrow.

original: 行く先々で友達に会う。

en.text: I meet friends wherever I go.

original: 友達の友達です。

en.text: She's a friend of a friend.

original: 友達は助け合うものだよ。

en.text: Friends help each other.

original: 友達の言う通りだよ。

en.text: Your friend is correct.
Your friend is right.

original: 犬は人間の最も忠実な友達です。

en.text: Dogs are humanity's most loyal companions.

original: 犬は人間の最も忠実な友達だ。

en.text: A dog is the most devoted friend.

original: 一番の友達は俺だろ？

en.text: I'm your best friend, right?
